text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon has conquered the Arima
Kinen!
She's done it!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon pulled it off!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but to be honest, my eyes were on
Narita
Brian the whole time...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
No, I get what you mean! Sure, Hishi
Amazon was
a bit faster this time, but
still...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian runs like a real beast, no
matter what
place she gets.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: (I got first place! I won! But...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
(Nobody cares how fierce the battle
was...
They've only got eyes for Brian!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Argh! This sucks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the Arima Kinen comes to a close,
everyone at the Nakayama Racecourse
finds themselves
completely enraptured
by Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She tells me she's going to pack her stuff
and
head back early, and then she's
gone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This was the battle of her dreams—and
she won!
But... she didn't look happy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My worries get the better of me, and I
rush back
to the academy to go find her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Grrraaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm greeted by the sound of a familiar
voice the
moment I reach campus.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I won the race but I lost the one-on-one!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: But so what?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'll channel all these frustrations
into my running! I
refuse to be overshadowed by
Narita Brian
forever!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You never know how a race'll turn out
till you run
it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She charges up the incline, shouting
words of
encouragement to herself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Nothing out there is impossible right
from the
get-go!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You never know the outcome of a match
till you
give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Pant... Phew!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She said those very same things to me
before I scouted her. It was her
straightforward honesty
that won me
over.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite the harsh reality in front of her,
she
remains stalwart and isn't afraid to
keep going.
choice_data_list: (She hasn't changed a bit since ba...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's only one thing I can say to
someone as
strong as her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Okay, one more time!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Wha?! Teach, when did you get here?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian is sure to show up at the
Arima Kinen
next year.
choice_data_list: Let's run in the Arima Kinen again...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell Hishi Amazon that it'll be
different—we'll
make it a one-on-one
that no one'll forget!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Teach, you...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Yeah! Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, we discuss our next steps. 
Considering the aptitude she showed for
miles and medium-distance races during
the Tiara
tour...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We decide to make our next goal the
Osaka Hai,
followed by the Yasuda
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Teach? This could be my ego
talking, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna get first place in both of
'em. I
won't
settle for less!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta step up to the challenge.
Otherwise, I
won't have a chance against
Narita Brian. She's
one heck of a beast.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together, we vow to win first place in
both races!
